thread:
Priya N: Hi finance team  I have a weird one. Charged for a rideshare and hotel minibar on my corporate card but bartender gave me a paper receipt for the minibar and Ramp won't accept it because it's handwritten. How strict are we on receipts?

Ben K: Handwritten receipts are usually allowed for small amounts if they include vendor name, date, amount, and signature. What's the minibar amount?

Priya N: Minibar  8.50 EUR. Rideshare  13.20 EUR (receipt screenshot from app attached). Ramp error: "receipt unrecognized: handwritten text" when I attach the photo.

Finance Bot: Automated policy note: For amounts <= 50, Finance accepts handwritten receipts with manager attestation. For carfare, screenshots from the provider app are acceptable if they show date/time and route. If missing, provide a short attestation note.

Priya N: OK uploading the photo again plus a manager attestation note.

Olga M: I approve the minibar 8.50 and the rideshare. Attestation: "I confirm receipt is valid for Priya N travel night 2026-03-10." Olga M (manager).

Priya N: Attached: minibar_photo.jpg, rideshare_screenshot.png, attestation note. Ramp URL: https://app.ramp.com/expenses/REDACTED/2187

Ben K: Thanks. I'll flag this for Payments to allow the handwritten receipt override. Also please add a short line in the Ramp notes explaining why the digital receipt wasn't available for minibar.

Payments Team: Noted. We'll accept the handwritten proof under policy and process reimbursement. Final check: can you confirm hotel charged the minibar to room or you paid cash?

Priya N: Paid cash at the bar, got the handwritten receipt.

Finance Bot: Created ticket FIN-2026-511 for manual validation. Expected processing: 2 business days for verification and ACH.

Ben K: Small compliance note  minibar VAT reclaim may be limited if vendor doesn't provide VAT ID. For under 50 it's usually non-material, but we'll try to capture vendor info. Priya, do you have the hotel's folio?

Priya N: I do. Uploaded hotel folio showing the hotel name and address but no VAT line for the bar.

Payments Team: Proceeding with reimbursement for full amounts as manager-approved. If VAT reclaim isn't possible, we'll treat it as expense with no reclaim. Processing ACH to bank last4 ending 4422 unless you prefer payroll.

Priya N: ACH is fine, bank last4 4422. Thanks all.

(2 days later)

Payments Team: ACH initiated for 1.70 EUR (total) ref PAY-2026-904. Please confirm when funds land. Ticket FIN-2026-511 set to Closed after payout.

Priya N: Received ACH today. All good, marking resolved. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
